1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# freeze.sh — cycle-130 ablation suite freeze (SDD §5.13, DEC-0404, DEC-0414)
     4	#
     5	# Writes or verifies <root>/MANIFEST.sha256, the suite's frozen identity: one
     6	# "<sha256>  <relpath>" line per file under <root>/tasks/ (and <root>/smoke/
     7	# with --smoke), relpath relative to the root, LC_ALL=C sorted, sha256 (Python
     8	# hashlib: no harness script sources .claude/ code, eval.yml trust boundary).
     9	# validate-suite.sh runs first; an invalid suite is never frozen or accepted.
    10	#
    11	# Usage:
    12	#   freeze.sh [--root DIR] [--smoke] [--check] [--allow-partial] [--suite-file F]
    13	#
    14	#   --root DIR        suite root (default grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0)
    15	#   --smoke           cover smoke/ too (passed to the validator as well)
    16	#   --check           recompute and compare with MANIFEST.sha256; write nothing
    17	#   --allow-partial   passed to validate-suite.sh (fewer than four tasks per type)
    18	#   --suite-file F    passed to validate-suite.sh
    19	#
    20	# Output: `freeze: wrote MANIFEST.sha256 (N files, sha256 <digest of the manifest>)`
    21	# or `freeze: OK — N files match MANIFEST.sha256 (sha256 …)`; on drift every
    22	# changed / added / removed path on its own line.
    23	#
    24	# Exit: 0 written / matches; 1 drift, missing manifest under --check, or the
    25	#       validator found violations; 2 usage.
    26	# Tested by evals/tests/freeze.bats.
    27	# =============================================================================
    28	set -euo pipefail
    29	export LC_ALL=C
    30	
    31	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    32	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    33	
    34	ROOT="$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0"
    35	CHECK=false SMOKE=false
    36	VARGS=()
    37	
    38	usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,26p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
    39	die() { echo "freeze: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    40	
    41	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    42	  case "$1" in
    43	    --root) ROOT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    44	    --smoke) SMOKE=true; VARGS+=(--smoke); shift ;;
    45	    --check) CHECK=true; shift ;;
    46	    --allow-partial) VARGS+=(--allow-partial); shift ;;
    47	    --suite-file) [[ -n "${2:-}" ]] || die "--suite-file needs a path"; VARGS+=(--suite-file "$2"); shift 2 ;;
    48	    --help|-h) usage ;;
    49	    *) die "unknown option: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    50	  esac
    51	done
    52	[[ -n "$ROOT" && -d "$ROOT" ]] || die "suite root not found: ${ROOT:-<empty>}"
    53	ROOT="$(cd "$ROOT" && pwd)"
    54	MANIFEST="$ROOT/MANIFEST.sha256"
    55	
    56	vrc=0
    57	"$SCRIPT_DIR/validate-suite.sh" --root "$ROOT" ${VARGS[@]+"${VARGS[@]}"} || vrc=$?
    58	if [[ $vrc -eq 1 ]]; then echo "freeze: refused — the suite does not validate" >&2; exit 1; fi
    59	[[ $vrc -eq 0 ]] || die "validate-suite.sh failed (exit $vrc)"
    60	
    61	# compute_manifest <out> — the manifest body for the current tree.
    62	compute_manifest() {
    63	  local out="$1" list dirs=(tasks)
    64	  [[ "$SMOKE" == "true" ]] && dirs+=(smoke)
    65	  list="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/freeze-list.XXXXXX")"
    66	  local d
    67	  for d in "${dirs[@]}"; do
    68	    [[ -d "$ROOT/$d" ]] || continue
    69	    ( cd "$ROOT" && find "$d" -type f -print )
    70	  done | LC_ALL=C sort > "$list"
    71	  if grep -q '\\' "$list"; then rm -f "$list"; die "a path under the suite holds a backslash"; fi
    72	  python3 -I - "$ROOT" "$list" > "$out" <<'PY' || { rm -f "$list"; die "hashing failed"; }
    73	import hashlib, os, sys
    74	root, listing = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
    75	for rel in open(listing, encoding="utf-8").read().splitlines():
    76	    if not rel:
    77	        continue
    78	    h = hashlib.sha256()
    79	    with open(os.path.join(root, rel), "rb") as f:
    80	        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
    81	            h.update(b)
    82	    print(h.hexdigest() + "  " + rel)
    83	PY
    84	  rm -f "$list"
    85	}
    86	digest_of() { python3 -I -c 'import hashlib, sys; print(hashlib.sha256(open(sys.argv[1], "rb").read()).hexdigest())' "$1"; }
    87	
    88	TMP="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/freeze.XXXXXX")"
    89	trap 'rm -f "$TMP"' EXIT
    90	compute_manifest "$TMP"
    91	n="$(grep -c . "$TMP" || true)"
    92	
    93	if [[ "$CHECK" == "true" ]]; then
    94	  [[ -f "$MANIFEST" ]] || { echo "freeze: no MANIFEST.sha256 in $ROOT (run freeze.sh first)" >&2; exit 1; }
    95	  if cmp -s "$TMP" "$MANIFEST"; then
    96	    echo "freeze: OK — $n files match MANIFEST.sha256 (sha256 $(digest_of "$MANIFEST"))"
    97	    exit 0
    98	  fi
    99	  echo "freeze: DRIFT against $MANIFEST:"
   100	  python3 -I - "$MANIFEST" "$TMP" <<'PY'
   101	import sys
   102	def load(p):
   103	    m = {}
   104	    for line in open(p, encoding="utf-8"):
   105	        line = line.rstrip("\n")
   106	        if line:
   107	            h, _, rel = line.partition("  ")
   108	            m[rel] = h
   109	    return m
   110	old, new = load(sys.argv[1]), load(sys.argv[2])
   111	for rel in sorted(set(old) | set(new)):
   112	    if rel not in new:
   113	        print(f"  removed  {rel}")
   114	    elif rel not in old:
   115	        print(f"  added    {rel}")
   116	    elif old[rel] != new[rel]:
   117	        print(f"  changed  {rel}")
   118	PY
   119	  exit 1
   120	fi
   121	
   122	cp "$TMP" "$MANIFEST.tmp" && mv "$MANIFEST.tmp" "$MANIFEST"
   123	echo "freeze: wrote MANIFEST.sha256 ($n files, sha256 $(digest_of "$MANIFEST"))"
   124	exit 0
     1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# fingerprint.sh — toolchain fingerprint for ablation runs (cycle-130 FR-4, SDD A11 / DEC-0389)
     4	#
     5	# Prints `fp:<sha256>` over the LC_ALL=C-sorted `tool=version` lines of the
     6	# toolchain an ablation run depends on (claude, codex, python3, node, yq, jq,
     7	# bats, git, docker) plus `source_tree=<HEAD of --source-tree>`. A tool that is
     8	# not installed reads `tool=absent`, so a missing tool changes the fingerprint
     9	# instead of failing the run. The value fills `image_digest` in host mode and
    10	# `fingerprint` in every mode (MANIFEST.json, pipeline.json, runs.jsonl). It reads the
    11	# HOST toolchain: in container mode the phases run on the image's toolchain, and the
    12	# image digest (not this value) identifies the batch's versions (on 2026-10-15 the host
    13	# CLI was 2.1.300 while Dockerfile.ablation pins 2.1.299).
    14	#
    15	# Usage:
    16	#   fingerprint.sh [--source-tree DIR] [--claude-bin B] [--bats-bin B] [--json]
    17	#
    18	# Options:
    19	#   --source-tree DIR  the pinned Loa tree; its `git rev-parse HEAD` is folded in
    20	#                      (`none` when absent or not a git tree)
    21	#   --claude-bin B     the CLI executable (default: $EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN, else claude)
    22	#   --bats-bin B       bats executable (default: bats on PATH, else the operator's
    23	#                      ~/.local/dotfiles/tools/diff-so-fancy/test/bats/bin/bats)
    24	#   --json             print {fingerprint, tools{}, source_tree, lines[]} instead
    25	#
    26	# Exit codes:
    27	#   0  printed
    28	#   2  usage error
    29	#
    30	# Tested by evals/tests/pipeline-run.bats (fingerprint cases).
    31	# =============================================================================
    32	set -euo pipefail
    33	export LC_ALL=C
    34	
    35	# Hashing is Python hashlib: no harness script sources .claude/ code (eval.yml
    36	# "Validate grader trust boundary").
    37	
    38	SOURCE_TREE=""
    39	CLAUDE_BIN="${EVAL_CLAUDE_BIN:-claude}"
    40	BATS_BIN="${LOA_EVAL_BATS_BIN:-}"
    41	JSON=false
    42	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    43	  case "$1" in
    44	    --source-tree) SOURCE_TREE="${2:?--source-tree needs a value}"; shift 2 ;;
    45	    --claude-bin)  CLAUDE_BIN="${2:?--claude-bin needs a value}"; shift 2 ;;
    46	    --bats-bin)    BATS_BIN="${2:?--bats-bin needs a value}"; shift 2 ;;
    47	    --json)        JSON=true; shift ;;
    48	    -h|--help)     sed -n '2,28p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
    49	    *) echo "fingerprint.sh: unknown argument: $1" >&2; exit 2 ;;
    50	  esac
    51	done
    52	if [[ -z "$BATS_BIN" ]]; then
    53	  if command -v bats >/dev/null 2>&1; then BATS_BIN=bats
    54	  else BATS_BIN="$HOME/.local/dotfiles/tools/diff-so-fancy/test/bats/bin/bats"; fi
    55	fi
    56	
    57	# first line of `<bin> <args>`, whitespace collapsed; `absent` when not runnable
    58	tool_version() {  # tool_version <bin> <args...>
    59	  local bin="$1"; shift
    60	  if ! command -v "$bin" >/dev/null 2>&1 && [[ ! -x "$bin" ]]; then printf 'absent'; return 0; fi
    61	  local out
    62	  out="$("$bin" "$@" 2>&1 < /dev/null || true)"
    63	  out="$(printf '%s\n' "$out" | sed -n '1p' | tr -s ' \t' ' ' | sed 's/^ //; s/ $//')"
    64	  [[ -n "$out" ]] || out="unknown"
    65	  printf '%s' "$out"
    66	}
    67	
    68	lines="$(
    69	  {
    70	    printf 'claude=%s\n'  "$(tool_version "$CLAUDE_BIN" --version)"
    71	    printf 'codex=%s\n'   "$(tool_version codex --version)"
    72	    printf 'python3=%s\n' "$(tool_version python3 --version)"
    73	    printf 'node=%s\n'    "$(tool_version node --version)"
    74	    printf 'yq=%s\n'      "$(tool_version yq --version)"
    75	    printf 'jq=%s\n'      "$(tool_version jq --version)"
    76	    printf 'bats=%s\n'    "$(tool_version "$BATS_BIN" --version)"
    77	    printf 'git=%s\n'     "$(tool_version git --version)"
    78	    printf 'docker=%s\n'  "$(tool_version docker --version)"
    79	  } | LC_ALL=C sort
    80	)"
    81	src="none"
    82	if [[ -n "$SOURCE_TREE" ]]; then
    83	  src="$(git -C "$SOURCE_TREE" rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo none)"
    84	fi
    85	lines="$lines"$'\n'"source_tree=$src"
    86	digest="$(printf '%s\n' "$lines" | python3 -I -c 'import hashlib, sys; print(hashlib.sha256(sys.stdin.buffer.read()).hexdigest())')"
    87	fp="fp:$digest"
    88	
    89	if [[ "$JSON" == true ]]; then
    90	  printf '%s\n' "$lines" | jq -Rn --arg fp "$fp" --arg src "$src" '
    91	    [inputs | select(length > 0)] as $l
    92	    | {fingerprint: $fp, source_tree: $src, lines: $l,
    93	       tools: ($l | map(select(startswith("source_tree=") | not) | capture("^(?<k>[^=]+)=(?<v>.*)$") | {(.k): .v}) | add)}'
    94	else
    95	  printf '%s\n' "$fp"
    96	fi

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# took-effect.sh — prove an arm's configuration took effect, from run artefacts
     4	# (cycle-130 FR-3/FR-7, SDD §1.4 D-4.2, §5.10; DEC-0418)
     5	#
     6	# Evaluates the rule ids the suite file lists under the arm's `took_effect` against
     7	# one run directory written by pipeline-run.sh (or every run under --batch-dir).
     8	# Evidence is read from what the run produced — meta/pipeline.json, the
     9	# meta/phase-<label>.argv.json captures (argv + environment), eval/model-invoke.jsonl,
    10	# the dissent envelopes and the sandbox tree — never from what the agent said.
    11	#
    12	# Rules:
    13	#   no_dot_claude              sandbox has no .claude/ and no CLAUDE.md
    14	#   no_system_prompt           no argv carries --append-system-prompt-file
    15	#   no_audit_rows              no sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl (no hook ran)
    16	#   all_phases_present         the phase records equal the arm's phase set for the task
    17	#                              type (skipped FIX rounds count as records); a run that
    18	#                              stopped early (cap_failure, agent_error, interrupted)
    19	#                              passes when its records are a prefix of the set
    20	#   no_plan_phase              no PLAN record
    21	#   one_voice_planned          both envelopes (review, audit) say companion_voice.planned false
    22	#   no_gate_phases             no REVIEW, AUDIT or FIX record
    23	#   enforce_env_false          every captured phase env has LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false
    24	#   no_flatline_rows           no eval/ MODELINV row whose calling_primitive starts with
    25	#                              flatline, and sandbox/grimoires/loa/sprint.md exists
    26	#   implementer_single_session one non-null session_id across the executed PLAN, IMPLEMENT
    27	#                              and FIX records, and every continuation's argv resumes it
    28	#   gates_separate_sessions    REVIEW and AUDIT session ids are non-null, distinct from
    29	#                              each other and from every implementer session id
    30	#   effort_flag_medium         every argv carries --effort medium
    31	#   skill_effort_stripped      no sandbox/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md frontmatter has an ^effort:
    32	#                              line (the block between the first two `---` lines; body lines
    33	#                              are not frontmatter)
    34	#   integrity_clean            arm_evidence.manifest_sha256 is present and every entry of
    35	#                              sandbox/.claude/checksums.json hashes to its recorded value
    36	#                              (Python hashlib walk); a loa_mount: false arm passes with
    37	#                              "no mount"
    38	#   applicability_refused      a refusal record (meta/refused.json) names this arm and a task
    39	#                              type outside its task_types; a run that was not refused passes
    40	#                              when its task type is inside task_types (and fails otherwise)
    41	# A refusal record is evaluated on applicability_refused alone.
    42	#
    43	# Usage:
    44	#   took-effect.sh --run-dir D --suite-file F [--arm ID] [--json]
    45	#   took-effect.sh --batch-dir D --suite-file F [--arm ID] [--json]
    46	#
    47	# Output: `arm <id>: <rule> OK|FAIL <evidence>` per rule, then `arm <id>: OK` or
    48	# `arm <id>: FAIL (<n> of <m> rules)`; --batch-dir adds `took-effect: <runs> runs, <k> failed`.
    49	# --json prints one object per run ({run_dir, arm, ok, rules: [{rule, ok, evidence}]}).
    50	#
    51	# Exit codes:
    52	#   0  every rule OK
    53	#   1  any rule FAIL
    54	#   2  usage error (missing files, unknown arm)
    55	#
    56	# Tested by evals/tests/took-effect.bats (fixture runs under
    57	# evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/).
    58	# =============================================================================
    59	set -euo pipefail
    60	export LC_ALL=C
    61	
    62	# Hashing is Python hashlib: no harness script sources .claude/ code (eval.yml
    63	# "Validate grader trust boundary").
    64	
    65	RUN_DIR="" BATCH_DIR="" SUITE_FILE="" ARM_OPT="" JSON=false
    66	usage() { echo "took-effect.sh: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    67	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    68	  case "$1" in
    69	    --run-dir)    RUN_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    70	    --batch-dir)  BATCH_DIR="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    71	    --suite-file) SUITE_FILE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    72	    --arm)        ARM_OPT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    73	    --json)       JSON=true; shift ;;
    74	    -h|--help)    sed -n '2,56p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
    75	    *) usage "unknown argument: $1" ;;
    76	  esac
    77	done
    78	[[ -n "$SUITE_FILE" && -f "$SUITE_FILE" ]] || usage "missing or unreadable --suite-file"
    79	[[ -n "$RUN_DIR" || -n "$BATCH_DIR" ]] || usage "one of --run-dir or --batch-dir is required"
    80	[[ -z "$RUN_DIR" || -z "$BATCH_DIR" ]] || usage "--run-dir and --batch-dir are exclusive"
    81	SUITE_JSON="$(yq -o=json '.' "$SUITE_FILE")" || usage "suite file does not parse"
    82	
    83	# ---- rule helpers: each sets EVID and returns 0 (OK) / 1 (FAIL) --------------------
    84	EVID=""
    85	argv_files() { local f; for f in "$R/meta"/phase-*.argv.json; do [[ -f "$f" ]] && printf '%s\n' "$f"; done; return 0; }
    86	envelope() {  # envelope <gate> → path or empty
    87	  local f="$R/sandbox/grimoires/loa/a2a/sprint-1/adversarial-$1.json"
    88	  [[ -f "$f" ]] || f="$R/eval/adversarial-$1.json"
    89	  [[ -f "$f" ]] && printf '%s' "$f"; return 0
    90	}
    91	
    92	expected_labels() {  # the arm's phase set for this run's task type (pipeline-run.sh's plan)
    93	  local type kind
    94	  type="$(jq -r '.task_type // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
    95	  if [[ "$type" == review-catch ]]; then kind=review-catch; else kind=build; fi
    96	  jq -r -n --argjson arm "$ARM_DEF" --argjson suite "$SUITE_JSON" --arg kind "$kind" \
    97	    --argjson tg "$(jq -c '.arm_toggles // {}' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")" '
    98	    (if $kind == "review-catch" then ["REVIEW","AUDIT"] else ["PLAN","IMPLEMENT","REVIEW","FIX","AUDIT","FIX"] end) as $dflt
    99	    | ($arm.phases // $suite.phase_sets[$kind] // $dflt) as $p0
   100	    | (if ($tg.loa_mount == false) then ["BARE"] else $p0 end) as $p1
   101	    | (if ($tg.sprint_plan == false) then ($p1 | map(select(. != "PLAN"))) else $p1 end) as $p2
   102	    | (if ($tg.gates == false) and ($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) != null then $p2[0:(($p2 | index("IMPLEMENT")) + 1)] else $p2 end) as $p3
   103	    | reduce $p3[] as $n ({out: [], fix: 0};
   104	        if $n == "FIX" then .fix += 1 | .out += ["FIX" + (.fix | tostring)] else .out += [$n] end)
   105	    | .out | join(",")'
   106	}
   107	
   108	rule_no_dot_claude() {
   109	  if [[ -e "$R/sandbox/.claude" || -e "$R/sandbox/CLAUDE.md" ]]; then EVID="sandbox has .claude/ or CLAUDE.md"; return 1; fi
   110	  EVID="sandbox has no .claude/ and no CLAUDE.md"
   111	}
   112	rule_no_system_prompt() {
   113	  local f n=0 hit=""
   114	  while IFS= read -r f; do
   115	    n=$((n + 1))
   116	    jq -e '(.argv // []) | index("--append-system-prompt-file") != null' "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 && hit="$hit $(basename "$f")"
   117	  done < <(argv_files)
   118	  [[ $n -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="no phase argv captured"; return 1; }
   119	  [[ -z "$hit" ]] || { EVID="--append-system-prompt-file in$hit"; return 1; }

   122	rule_no_audit_rows() {

   124	  EVID="no sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl"

   126	rule_all_phases_present() {
   127	  local want got st

   133	    cap_failure|agent_error|interrupted|running)
   134	      if [[ -n "$got" && ",$want," == ",$got,"* ]]; then EVID="phases $got (run stopped: $st; set $want)"; return 0; fi ;;
   135	  esac

   138	rule_no_plan_phase() {
   139	  local n; n="$(jq '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "PLAN")] | length' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"

   143	rule_one_voice_planned() {
   144	  local g f v bad="" ev=""

   149	                elif (.companion_voice | type) == "object" then .companion_voice.planned else "absent" end | tostring' "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo unreadable)"
   150	    ev="$ev $g:planned=$v"

   156	rule_no_gate_phases() {

   161	rule_enforce_env_false() {

   171	rule_no_flatline_rows() {

   173	  if [[ -f "$R/eval/model-invoke.jsonl" ]]; then
   174	    n="$(jq -R -n '[inputs | fromjson? | select(type == "object")
   175	           | (.payload.calling_primitive // .calling_primitive // .agent // "") | select(test("^flatline"))] | length' \
   176	         "$R/eval/model-invoke.jsonl")"

   182	rule_implementer_single_session() {
   183	  local ids n sid f bad=""
   184	  ids="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.skipped != true and (.name == "PLAN" or .name == "IMPLEMENT" or .name == "FIX")) | .session_id]' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   185	  n="$(jq 'length' <<<"$ids")"

   187	  [[ "$(jq '[.[] | select(. == null)] | length' <<<"$ids")" -eq 0 ]] || { EVID="an implementer record has no session_id"; return 1; }
   188	  [[ "$(jq 'unique | length' <<<"$ids")" -eq 1 ]] || { EVID="implementer session ids $(jq -r 'unique | join(",")' <<<"$ids")"; return 1; }
   189	  sid="$(jq -r '.[0]' <<<"$ids")"

   191	    case "$(jq -r '.name' "$f")" in PLAN|IMPLEMENT|FIX) ;; *) continue ;; esac
   192	    jq -e '.resume == null' "$f" >/dev/null && continue
   193	    jq -e --arg s "$sid" '.resume == $s and ((.argv | index("--resume")) as $i | $i != null and .argv[$i + 1] == $s)' "$f" >/dev/null \
   194	      || bad="$bad $(jq -r '.label' "$f")"

   199	rule_gates_separate_sessions() {
   200	  local r a impl
   201	  r="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "REVIEW" and .skipped != true) | .session_id][0] // "null"' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   202	  a="$(jq -r '[.phases // [] | .[] | select(.name == "AUDIT" and .skipped != true) | .session_id][0] // "null"' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"

   204	  [[ "$r" != null && "$a" != null ]] || { EVID="gate session ids review=$r audit=$a"; return 1; }
   205	  [[ "$r" != "$a" ]] || { EVID="REVIEW and AUDIT share session $r"; return 1; }
   206	  if jq -e --arg r "$r" --arg a "$a" 'index($r) != null or index($a) != null' <<<"$impl" >/dev/null; then
   207	    EVID="a gate shares an implementer session"; return 1
   208	  fi
   209	  EVID="review $r, audit $a, implementer $(jq -r 'join(",")' <<<"$impl")"
   210	}
   211	rule_effort_flag_medium() {
   212	  local f n=0 ok=0
   213	  while IFS= read -r f; do
   214	    n=$((n + 1))
   215	    jq -e '(.argv // []) | (index("--effort")) as $i | $i != null and .[$i + 1] == "medium"' "$f" >/dev/null && ok=$((ok + 1))
   216	  done < <(argv_files)

   218	  EVID="--effort medium on $ok/$n phases"

   220	rule_skill_effort_stripped() {
   221	  local f n=0 hit=0
   222	  for f in "$R"/sandbox/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md; do
   223	    [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
   224	    n=$((n + 1))

   226	    awk 'NR == 1 && $0 != "---" {exit} NR > 1 && $0 == "---" {exit} NR > 1 && /^effort:/ {hit = 1; exit} END {exit !hit}' "$f" \

   233	rule_integrity_clean() {
   234	  local man="$R/sandbox/.claude/checksums.json" msha out
   235	  if [[ "$(jq -r '.arm_toggles.loa_mount' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")" == false ]]; then
   236	    [[ -e "$R/sandbox/.claude" ]] && { EVID="loa_mount: false but sandbox has .claude/"; return 1; }
   237	    EVID="no mount (loa_mount: false)"; return 0
   238	  fi
   239	  msha="$(jq -r '.arm_evidence.manifest_sha256 // empty' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   240	  [[ -n "$msha" && "$msha" != none ]] || { EVID="no arm_evidence.manifest_sha256"; return 1; }
   241	  [[ -f "$man" ]] && jq -e '.files | type == "object"' "$man" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { EVID="no sandbox .claude/checksums.json files map"; return 1; }
   242	  # one hashlib walk over every manifest entry: "<n> <tampered> <missing> <file-sha> <first problem>"
   243	  out="$(python3 -I -c '
   244	import hashlib, json, os, sys
   245	root, man = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
   246	def sha(p):
   247	    h = hashlib.sha256()
   248	    with open(p, "rb") as f:
   249	        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
   250	            h.update(b)
   251	    return h.hexdigest()
   252	files = json.load(open(man)).get("files") or {}
   253	bad = missing = 0; first = "-"
   254	for rel, want in sorted(files.items()):
   255	    p = os.path.join(root, rel)
   256	    if not os.path.isfile(p):
   257	        missing += 1; first = first if first != "-" else "missing " + rel
   258	    elif sha(p) != want:
   259	        bad += 1; first = first if first != "-" else "tampered " + rel
   260	print(len(files), bad, missing, sha(man), first)' "$R/sandbox" "$man")" || { EVID="hash walk failed"; return 1; }
   261	  local n bad missing filesha first
   262	  read -r n bad missing filesha first <<<"$out"
   263	  [[ "$n" -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="manifest lists no files"; return 1; }
   264	  if [[ "$bad" -gt 0 || "$missing" -gt 0 ]]; then EVID="$bad tampered, $missing missing of $n ($first)"; return 1; fi
   265	  EVID="$n manifest entries verified; manifest_sha256 ${msha:0:12}"
   266	  [[ "$filesha" == "$msha" ]] && EVID="$EVID (matches checksums.json)"
   267	  return 0
   268	}
   269	rule_applicability_refused() {
   270	  local f="$R/meta/refused.json" a t
   271	  if [[ ! -f "$f" ]]; then
   272	    # a run that was not refused: its task type must be one the arm declares
   273	    t="$(jq -r '.task_type // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   274	    local k=build; [[ "$t" == review-catch ]] && k=review-catch
   275	    if jq -e --arg k "$k" --arg t "$t" '(.task_types // ["all"]) as $tt | ($tt | index("all")) or ($tt | index($k)) or ($tt | index($t))' \
   276	         <<<"$ARM_DEF" >/dev/null; then
   277	      EVID="applicable: $t in task_types $(jq -c '.task_types // null' <<<"$ARM_DEF") (no refusal needed)"; return 0
   278	    fi
   279	    EVID="ran on $t outside task_types $(jq -c '.task_types // null' <<<"$ARM_DEF") without a refusal record"; return 1
   280	  fi
   281	  a="$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$f")"; t="$(jq -r '.type // ""' "$f")"
   282	  [[ "$a" == "$ARM" && -n "$t" ]] || { EVID="refusal record names arm '$a' type '$t'"; return 1; }
   283	  local kind=build; [[ "$t" == review-catch ]] && kind=review-catch
   284	  if jq -e --arg k "$kind" --arg t "$t" '(.task_types // ["all"]) as $tt | ($tt | index("all")) or ($tt | index($k)) or ($tt | index($t))' \
   285	       <<<"$ARM_DEF" >/dev/null; then
   286	    EVID="arm task_types $(jq -c '.task_types' <<<"$ARM_DEF") include $t, yet the run was refused"; return 1
   287	  fi
   288	  EVID="refused $t (task_types $(jq -c '.task_types // null' <<<"$ARM_DEF"))"
   289	}
   290	
   291	# ---- one run ------------------------------------------------------------------------
   292	check_run() {  # check_run <run-dir> → prints lines; returns 0/1; 2 on usage problems
   293	  R="$1"
   294	  local arm rules rule fails=0 total=0 results='[]' ok
   295	  if [[ -n "$ARM_OPT" ]]; then arm="$ARM_OPT"
   296	  elif [[ -f "$R/meta/arm" ]]; then arm="$(sed -n '1p' "$R/meta/arm" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
   297	  elif [[ -f "$R/meta/refused.json" ]]; then arm="$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$R/meta/refused.json")"
   298	  else arm="$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json" 2>/dev/null || true)"; fi
   299	  [[ -n "$arm" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: no arm for $R" >&2; return 2; }
   300	  ARM="$arm"
   301	  ARM_DEF="$(jq -c --arg a "$arm" '[.arms // [] | .[] | select(.id == $a)][0] // empty' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
   302	  [[ -n "$ARM_DEF" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: arm $arm is not declared in the suite" >&2; return 2; }
   303	  if [[ "$(jq -r '.absent // false' <<<"$ARM_DEF")" == true ]]; then
   304	    if [[ "$JSON" == true ]]; then jq -nc --arg d "$R" --arg arm "$arm" '{run_dir: $d, arm: $arm, ok: true, absent: true, rules: []}'
   305	    else printf 'arm %s: absent (component-absent; no rules)\n' "$arm"; fi
   306	    return 0
   307	  fi
   308	  if [[ -f "$R/meta/refused.json" ]]; then
   309	    rules="applicability_refused"
   310	  else
   311	    [[ -f "$R/meta/pipeline.json" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: no meta/pipeline.json under $R" >&2; return 2; }
   312	    rules="$(jq -r '(.took_effect // []) | .[]' <<<"$ARM_DEF")"
   313	    [[ -n "$rules" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: arm $arm lists no took_effect rules" >&2; return 2; }
   314	  fi
   315	  while IFS= read -r rule; do
   316	    [[ -n "$rule" ]] || continue
   317	    total=$((total + 1)); EVID=""
   318	    if declare -F "rule_$rule" >/dev/null; then
   319	      if "rule_$rule"; then ok=true; else ok=false; fi
   320	    else
   321	      ok=false; EVID="unknown rule id"
   322	    fi
   323	    [[ "$ok" == true ]] || fails=$((fails + 1))
   324	    if [[ "$JSON" == true ]]; then
   325	      results="$(jq -c --arg r "$rule" --argjson ok "$ok" --arg e "$EVID" '. + [{rule: $r, ok: $ok, evidence: $e}]' <<<"$results")"
   326	    else
   327	      printf 'arm %s: %s %s %s\n' "$arm" "$rule" "$([[ "$ok" == true ]] && echo OK || echo FAIL)" "$EVID"
   328	    fi
   329	  done <<<"$rules"
   330	  if [[ "$JSON" == true ]]; then
   331	    jq -nc --arg d "$R" --arg arm "$arm" --argjson rules "$results" --argjson ok "$([[ $fails -eq 0 ]] && echo true || echo false)" \
   332	      '{run_dir: $d, arm: $arm, ok: $ok, rules: $rules}'
   333	  elif [[ $fails -eq 0 ]]; then
   334	    printf 'arm %s: OK\n' "$arm"
   335	  else
   336	    printf 'arm %s: FAIL (%d of %d rules)\n' "$arm" "$fails" "$total"
   337	  fi
   338	  [[ $fails -eq 0 ]]
   339	}
   340	
   341	if [[ -n "$RUN_DIR" ]]; then
   342	  [[ -d "$RUN_DIR" ]] || usage "run dir not found: $RUN_DIR"
   343	  rc=0; check_run "$RUN_DIR" || rc=$?
   344	  exit "$rc"
   345	fi
   346	
   347	[[ -d "$BATCH_DIR" ]] || usage "batch dir not found: $BATCH_DIR"
   348	runs=0 failed=0
   349	while IFS= read -r d; do
   350	  runs=$((runs + 1))
   351	  rc=0; check_run "$d" || rc=$?
   352	  [[ $rc -eq 2 ]] && exit 2
   353	  [[ $rc -eq 0 ]] || failed=$((failed + 1))
   354	done < <(find "$BATCH_DIR" -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 4 -type d -name meta \
   355	           \( -exec test -f '{}/pipeline.json' \; -o -exec test -f '{}/refused.json' \; \) -print \
   356	         | sed 's|/meta$||' | LC_ALL=C sort)
   357	[[ $runs -gt 0 ]] || usage "no run directories under $BATCH_DIR"
   358	[[ "$JSON" == true ]] || printf 'took-effect: %d runs, %d failed\n' "$runs" "$failed"
   359	[[ $failed -eq 0 ]]

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# took-effect.sh — prove an arm's configuration took effect, from run artefacts
     4	# (cycle-130 FR-3/FR-7, SDD §1.4 D-4.2, §5.10; DEC-0418)
     5	#
     6	# Evaluates the rule ids the suite file lists under the arm's `took_effect` against
     7	# one run directory written by pipeline-run.sh (or every run under --batch-dir).
     8	# Evidence is read from what the run produced — meta/pipeline.json, the
     9	# meta/phase-<label>.argv.json captures (argv + environment), eval/model-invoke.jsonl,
    10	# the dissent envelopes and the sandbox tree — never from what the agent said.
    11	#
    12	# Rules:
    13	#   no_dot_claude              sandbox has no .claude/ and no CLAUDE.md
    14	#   no_system_prompt           no argv carries --append-system-prompt-file
    15	#   no_audit_rows              no sandbox/.run/audit.jsonl (no hook ran)
    16	#   all_phases_present         the phase records equal the arm's phase set for the task
    17	#                              type (skipped FIX rounds count as records); a run that
    18	#                              stopped early (cap_failure, agent_error, interrupted)
    19	#                              passes when its records are a prefix of the set
    20	#   no_plan_phase              no PLAN record
    21	#   one_voice_planned          both envelopes (review, audit) say companion_voice.planned false
    22	#   no_gate_phases             no REVIEW, AUDIT or FIX record
    23	#   enforce_env_false          every captured phase env has LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false
    24	#   no_flatline_rows           no eval/ MODELINV row whose calling_primitive starts with
    25	#                              flatline, and sandbox/grimoires/loa/sprint.md exists
    26	#   implementer_single_session one non-null session_id across the executed PLAN, IMPLEMENT
    27	#                              and FIX records, and every continuation's argv resumes it
    28	#   gates_separate_sessions    REVIEW and AUDIT session ids are non-null, distinct from
    29	#                              each other and from every implementer session id
    30	#   effort_flag_medium         every argv carries --effort medium
    31	#   skill_effort_stripped      no sandbox/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md frontmatter has an ^effort:
    32	#                              line (the block between the first two `---` lines; body lines
    33	#                              are not frontmatter)
    34	#   integrity_clean            arm_evidence.manifest_sha256 is present and every entry of
    35	#                              sandbox/.claude/checksums.json hashes to its recorded value
    36	#                              (Python hashlib walk); a loa_mount: false arm passes with
    37	#                              "no mount"
    38	#   applicability_refused      a refusal record (meta/refused.json) names this arm and a task
    39	#                              type outside its task_types; a run that was not refused passes
    40	#                              when its task type is inside task_types (and fails otherwise)
    41	# A refusal record is evaluated on applicability_refused alone.
    42	#
    43	# Usage:
    44	#   took-effect.sh --run-dir D --suite-file F [--arm ID] [--json]
    45	#   took-effect.sh --batch-dir D --suite-file F [--arm ID] [--json]
    46	#
    47	# Output: `arm <id>: <rule> OK|FAIL <evidence>` per rule, then `arm <id>: OK` or
    48	# `arm <id>: FAIL (<n> of <m> rules)`; --batch-dir adds `took-effect: <runs> runs, <k> failed`.
    49	# --json prints one object per run ({run_dir, arm, ok, rules: [{rule, ok, evidence}]}).
    50	#
    51	# Exit codes:
    52	#   0  every rule OK
    53	#   1  any rule FAIL
    54	#   2  usage error (missing files, unknown arm)
    55	#
    56	# Tested by evals/tests/took-effect.bats (fixture runs under
    57	# evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-runs/).
    58	# =============================================================================
    59	set -euo pipefail
    60	export LC_ALL=C
    61	
    62	# Hashing is Python hashlib: no harness script sources .claude/ code (eval.yml
    63	# "Validate grader trust boundary").
    64	
    65	RUN_DIR="" BATCH_DIR="" SUITE_FILE="" ARM_OPT="" JSON=false
    66	usage() { echo "took-effect.sh: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    67	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do

   233	rule_integrity_clean() {
   234	  local man="$R/sandbox/.claude/checksums.json" msha out
   235	  if [[ "$(jq -r '.arm_toggles.loa_mount' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")" == false ]]; then
   236	    [[ -e "$R/sandbox/.claude" ]] && { EVID="loa_mount: false but sandbox has .claude/"; return 1; }
   237	    EVID="no mount (loa_mount: false)"; return 0
   238	  fi
   239	  msha="$(jq -r '.arm_evidence.manifest_sha256 // empty' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   240	  [[ -n "$msha" && "$msha" != none ]] || { EVID="no arm_evidence.manifest_sha256"; return 1; }
   241	  [[ -f "$man" ]] && jq -e '.files | type == "object"' "$man" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { EVID="no sandbox .claude/checksums.json files map"; return 1; }
   242	  # one hashlib walk over every manifest entry: "<n> <tampered> <missing> <file-sha> <first problem>"
   243	  out="$(python3 -I -c '
   244	import hashlib, json, os, sys
   245	root, man = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
   246	def sha(p):
   247	    h = hashlib.sha256()
   248	    with open(p, "rb") as f:
   249	        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
   250	            h.update(b)
   251	    return h.hexdigest()
   252	files = json.load(open(man)).get("files") or {}
   253	bad = missing = 0; first = "-"
   254	for rel, want in sorted(files.items()):
   255	    p = os.path.join(root, rel)
   256	    if not os.path.isfile(p):
   257	        missing += 1; first = first if first != "-" else "missing " + rel
   258	    elif sha(p) != want:
   259	        bad += 1; first = first if first != "-" else "tampered " + rel
   260	print(len(files), bad, missing, sha(man), first)' "$R/sandbox" "$man")" || { EVID="hash walk failed"; return 1; }
   261	  local n bad missing filesha first
   262	  read -r n bad missing filesha first <<<"$out"
   263	  [[ "$n" -gt 0 ]] || { EVID="manifest lists no files"; return 1; }
   264	  if [[ "$bad" -gt 0 || "$missing" -gt 0 ]]; then EVID="$bad tampered, $missing missing of $n ($first)"; return 1; fi
   265	  EVID="$n manifest entries verified; manifest_sha256 ${msha:0:12}"
   266	  [[ "$filesha" == "$msha" ]] && EVID="$EVID (matches checksums.json)"
   267	  return 0
   268	}
   269	rule_applicability_refused() {
   270	  local f="$R/meta/refused.json" a t
   271	  if [[ ! -f "$f" ]]; then
   272	    # a run that was not refused: its task type must be one the arm declares
   273	    t="$(jq -r '.task_type // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json")"
   274	    local k=build; [[ "$t" == review-catch ]] && k=review-catch
   275	    if jq -e --arg k "$k" --arg t "$t" '(.task_types // ["all"]) as $tt | ($tt | index("all")) or ($tt | index($k)) or ($tt | index($t))' \
   276	         <<<"$ARM_DEF" >/dev/null; then
   277	      EVID="applicable: $t in task_types $(jq -c '.task_types // null' <<<"$ARM_DEF") (no refusal needed)"; return 0
   278	    fi
   279	    EVID="ran on $t outside task_types $(jq -c '.task_types // null' <<<"$ARM_DEF") without a refusal record"; return 1
   280	  fi
   281	  a="$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$f")"; t="$(jq -r '.type // ""' "$f")"
   282	  [[ "$a" == "$ARM" && -n "$t" ]] || { EVID="refusal record names arm '$a' type '$t'"; return 1; }
   283	  local kind=build; [[ "$t" == review-catch ]] && kind=review-catch
   284	  if jq -e --arg k "$kind" --arg t "$t" '(.task_types // ["all"]) as $tt | ($tt | index("all")) or ($tt | index($k)) or ($tt | index($t))' \
   285	       <<<"$ARM_DEF" >/dev/null; then
   286	    EVID="arm task_types $(jq -c '.task_types' <<<"$ARM_DEF") include $t, yet the run was refused"; return 1
   287	  fi
   288	  EVID="refused $t (task_types $(jq -c '.task_types // null' <<<"$ARM_DEF"))"
   289	}
   290	
   291	# ---- one run ------------------------------------------------------------------------
   292	check_run() {  # check_run <run-dir> → prints lines; returns 0/1; 2 on usage problems
   293	  R="$1"
   294	  local arm rules rule fails=0 total=0 results='[]' ok
   295	  if [[ -n "$ARM_OPT" ]]; then arm="$ARM_OPT"
   296	  elif [[ -f "$R/meta/arm" ]]; then arm="$(sed -n '1p' "$R/meta/arm" | tr -d '[:space:]')"
   297	  elif [[ -f "$R/meta/refused.json" ]]; then arm="$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$R/meta/refused.json")"
   298	  else arm="$(jq -r '.arm // ""' "$R/meta/pipeline.json" 2>/dev/null || true)"; fi
   299	  [[ -n "$arm" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: no arm for $R" >&2; return 2; }
   300	  ARM="$arm"
   301	  ARM_DEF="$(jq -c --arg a "$arm" '[.arms // [] | .[] | select(.id == $a)][0] // empty' <<<"$SUITE_JSON")"
   302	  [[ -n "$ARM_DEF" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: arm $arm is not declared in the suite" >&2; return 2; }
   303	  if [[ "$(jq -r '.absent // false' <<<"$ARM_DEF")" == true ]]; then
   304	    if [[ "$JSON" == true ]]; then jq -nc --arg d "$R" --arg arm "$arm" '{run_dir: $d, arm: $arm, ok: true, absent: true, rules: []}'
   305	    else printf 'arm %s: absent (component-absent; no rules)\n' "$arm"; fi
   306	    return 0
   307	  fi
   308	  if [[ -f "$R/meta/refused.json" ]]; then
   309	    rules="applicability_refused"
   310	  else
   311	    [[ -f "$R/meta/pipeline.json" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: no meta/pipeline.json under $R" >&2; return 2; }
   312	    rules="$(jq -r '(.took_effect // []) | .[]' <<<"$ARM_DEF")"
   313	    [[ -n "$rules" ]] || { echo "took-effect.sh: arm $arm lists no took_effect rules" >&2; return 2; }
   314	  fi
   315	  while IFS= read -r rule; do
   316	    [[ -n "$rule" ]] || continue
   317	    total=$((total + 1)); EVID=""
   318	    if declare -F "rule_$rule" >/dev/null; then
   319	      if "rule_$rule"; then ok=true; else ok=false; fi
   320	    else
   321	      ok=false; EVID="unknown rule id"
   322	    fi
   323	    [[ "$ok" == true ]] || fails=$((fails + 1))
   324	    if [[ "$JSON" == true ]]; then
   325	      results="$(jq -c --arg r "$rule" --argjson ok "$ok" --arg e "$EVID" '. + [{rule: $r, ok: $ok, evidence: $e}]' <<<"$results")"
   326	    else
   327	      printf 'arm %s: %s %s %s\n' "$arm" "$rule" "$([[ "$ok" == true ]] && echo OK || echo FAIL)" "$EVID"
   328	    fi
   329	  done <<<"$rules"
   330	  if [[ "$JSON" == true ]]; then
   331	    jq -nc --arg d "$R" --arg arm "$arm" --argjson rules "$results" --argjson ok "$([[ $fails -eq 0 ]] && echo true || echo false)" \
   332	      '{run_dir: $d, arm: $arm, ok: $ok, rules: $rules}'
   333	  elif [[ $fails -eq 0 ]]; then
   334	    printf 'arm %s: OK\n' "$arm"
   335	  else
   336	    printf 'arm %s: FAIL (%d of %d rules)\n' "$arm" "$fails" "$total"
   337	  fi
   338	  [[ $fails -eq 0 ]]
   339	}
   340	
   341	if [[ -n "$RUN_DIR" ]]; then
   342	  [[ -d "$RUN_DIR" ]] || usage "run dir not found: $RUN_DIR"
   343	  rc=0; check_run "$RUN_DIR" || rc=$?
   344	  exit "$rc"
   345	fi
   346	
   347	[[ -d "$BATCH_DIR" ]] || usage "batch dir not found: $BATCH_DIR"

   349	while IFS= read -r d; do
   350	  runs=$((runs + 1))

   352	  [[ $rc -eq 2 ]] && exit 2
   353	  [[ $rc -eq 0 ]] || failed=$((failed + 1))
   354	done < <(find "$BATCH_DIR" -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 4 -type d -name meta \
   355	           \( -exec test -f '{}/pipeline.json' \; -o -exec test -f '{}/refused.json' \; \) -print \
   356	         | sed 's|/meta$||' | LC_ALL=C sort)

   358	[[ "$JSON" == true ]] || printf 'took-effect: %d runs, %d failed\n' "$runs" "$failed"
   359	[[ $failed -eq 0 ]]

--- base/.claude/scripts/preflight.sh	2026-10-21 04:04:22.861558387 +0000

         # Simple check: compare file count (full SHA verification would be more thorough)
         EXPECTED_COUNT=$(jq -r '.files | length' "${PROJECT_ROOT}/.claude/checksums.json" 2>/dev/null || echo "0")
-        ACTUAL_COUNT=$(find "${PROJECT_ROOT}/.claude" -type f ! -path "*/.git/*" ! -path "*/overrides/*" ! -path "*/checksums.json" | wc -l)
+        # cycle-130 FR-1 (#1267): the manifest is generated from the TRACKED
+        # .claude/ tree (tools/gen-checksums.sh), so count with the same rule:
+        # git ls-files -- .claude minus overrides/ and the manifest. In a
+        # submodule mount .claude/checksums.json links into the submodule; the
+        # count is taken in the tree that owns the manifest.
+        MANIFEST_TREE="${PROJECT_ROOT}"
+        if [[ -L "${PROJECT_ROOT}/.claude/checksums.json" ]]; then
+            MANIFEST_LINK=$(readlink "${PROJECT_ROOT}/.claude/checksums.json")
+            [[ "${MANIFEST_LINK}" == /* ]] || MANIFEST_LINK="${PROJECT_ROOT}/.claude/${MANIFEST_LINK}"
+            MANIFEST_TREE=$(cd "$(dirname "${MANIFEST_LINK}")/.." 2>/dev/null && pwd -P) || MANIFEST_TREE="${PROJECT_ROOT}"
+        fi
+        ACTUAL_COUNT=0
+        if git -C "${MANIFEST_TREE}" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+            ACTUAL_COUNT=$(git -C "${MANIFEST_TREE}" ls-files -- .claude \
+                | awk '!/^\.claude\/overrides\// && $0 != ".claude/checksums.json"' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
+        fi
+        # No tracked .claude/ in that tree (outside git, or a standard-mode
+        # downstream that does not commit .claude/): keep the legacy count.
+        if [[ "${ACTUAL_COUNT}" -eq 0 ]]; then
+            ACTUAL_COUNT=$(find "${PROJECT_ROOT}/.claude" -type f ! -path "*/.git/*" ! -path "*/overrides/*" ! -path "*/checksums.json" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
+        fi
 
         if [[ "${EXPECTED_COUNT}" != "${ACTUAL_COUNT}" ]]; then
             echo "⚠️  System Zone integrity check: file count mismatch" >&2

 }

    15	# manifest itself (`.claude/checksums.json`), hashes each with

    30	# Options:

    35	#   --check      regenerate to a temp file and compare its `files` map with

    37	#   -h, --help   this text

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# validate-suite.sh — cycle-130 ablation task-suite validator (SDD §3.2, DEC-0424)
     4	#
     5	# Checks every task of the ablation-2.0 suite before it is frozen, run or graded.
     6	#
     7	# Usage:
     8	#   validate-suite.sh [--root DIR] [--smoke] [--allow-partial] [--suite-file F]
     9	#
    10	#   --root DIR        suite root (default grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0); the
    11	#                     tasks are <root>/tasks/<id>/task.yaml
    12	#   --smoke           also validate <root>/smoke/<id>/task.yaml (never counted)
    13	#   --allow-partial   skip the four-by-four type count (Sprint 258 state)
    14	#   --suite-file F    suite yaml (default evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml): arm ids
    15	#                     for the leakage check, arms' task_types, suite_version
    16	#
    17	# Checks (each violation is one stdout line `<task-id>: <reason>`):
    18	#   1. schema: id (= directory name), schema_version 1, type (feature-build |
    19	#      bug-fix | refactor | review-catch), source {kind, date, fix_commit?,
    20	#      base_commit?, bead?, origin?}, post_cutoff (bool), fixture (dir under the
    21	#      root; null only for review-catch), criterion (agent-facing; no path, file
    22	#      name or test name), success_criterion, test_command (array; null only for
    23	#      review-catch), regression_command (array | null), reference_patch (hidden/…
    24	#      | null; required for bug-fix and feature-build), grader_protected (array of
    25	#      relative paths present in the fixture), structural_check (hidden/… | null;
    26	#      required for refactor), bounds {max_turns{}, timeout_min{}} (phase → positive
    27	#      int), review_catch (null, or {fixture, manifest, labels?} for review-catch,
    28	#      both present), suite_version (= the suite file's), TASK.md present
    29	#   2. counts: four tasks of each type under tasks/ (unless --allow-partial)
    30	#   3. allowlist: test_command[0] and regression_command[0] in python3 | pytest |
    31	#      bats | bash | node | npx
    32	#   4. hidden/manifest.json (build types): {"files": [{src, dest}]}; every src
    33	#      exists under hidden/; every dest is relative, inside the tree, no `..`
    34	#   5. fixture path rule (build types): check_fixture_path_rule from
    35	#      lib/sandbox-mount.sh — no .claude/, CLAUDE.md, .loa.config.yaml, grimoires/
    36	#      or .run/ at the fixture's top level; the reference patch touches none either
    37	#   6. leakage: TASK.md and criterion (the task-brief text is built from these)
    38	#      and every phase prompt under evals/harness/lib/phase-prompts/ contain none
    39	#      of: the string `hidden` (any case), a hidden test file's stem, a defect id
    40	#      of the review manifest, a `D[0-9]{2}-` key, an arm id of the suite file
    41	#   7. suite file: every non-absent arm's task_types are known (all | build |
    42	#      review-catch | feature-build | bug-fix | refactor)
    43	#
    44	# Exit: 0 valid; 1 violations (every one listed); 2 usage / unreadable input.
    45	# Tested by evals/tests/validate-suite.bats.
    46	# =============================================================================
    47	set -euo pipefail
    48	export LC_ALL=C
    49	
    50	SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    51	REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    52	ROOT="$REPO_ROOT/grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0"
    53	SUITE_FILE="$REPO_ROOT/evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml"
    54	PROMPTS_DIR="${LOA_EVAL_PHASE_PROMPTS_DIR:-$SCRIPT_DIR/lib/phase-prompts}"
    55	SMOKE=false ALLOW_PARTIAL=false
    56	
    57	usage() { sed -n '2,/^# =====.*$/p' "$0" | sed -n '2,45p' | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//' >&2; exit 2; }
    58	die() { echo "validate-suite: $*" >&2; exit 2; }
    59	
    60	while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    61	  case "$1" in
    62	    --root) ROOT="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    63	    --smoke) SMOKE=true; shift ;;
    64	    --allow-partial) ALLOW_PARTIAL=true; shift ;;
    65	    --suite-file) SUITE_FILE="${2:-}"; shift 2 ;;
    66	    --help|-h) usage ;;
    67	    *) die "unknown option: $1 (see --help)" ;;
    68	  esac
    69	done
    70	[[ -n "$ROOT" && -d "$ROOT" ]] || die "suite root not found: ${ROOT:-<empty>}"
    71	ROOT="$(cd "$ROOT" && pwd)"
    72	[[ -f "$SUITE_FILE" ]] || die "suite file not found: $SUITE_FILE"
    73	for tool in yq jq python3; do command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "missing tool: $tool"; done
    74	# eval.yml trust boundary: a literal in-tree path, no variable on the source line
    75	pushd "$SCRIPT_DIR" >/dev/null
    76	# shellcheck source=lib/sandbox-mount.sh
    77	source ./lib/sandbox-mount.sh
    78	popd >/dev/null
    79	
    80	WORK="$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/validate-suite.XXXXXX")"
    81	trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
    82	yq -o=json '.' "$SUITE_FILE" > "$WORK/suite.json" 2>/dev/null || die "suite file is not valid YAML: $SUITE_FILE"
    83	
    84	# Collect task directories: tasks/* (counted) and smoke/* (with --smoke).
    85	: > "$WORK/tasks.tsv"
    86	for group in tasks smoke; do
    87	  [[ "$group" == "smoke" && "$SMOKE" != "true" ]] && continue
    88	  [[ -d "$ROOT/$group" ]] || continue
    89	  for d in "$ROOT/$group"/*/; do
    90	    [[ -d "$d" ]] || continue
    91	    d="${d%/}"
    92	    n="$(basename "$d")"
    93	    j="$WORK/$group.$n.json"
    94	    if [[ ! -f "$d/task.yaml" ]]; then
    95	      printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$group" "$n" "$d" "-" >> "$WORK/tasks.tsv"; continue
    96	    fi
    97	    if yq -o=json '.' "$d/task.yaml" > "$j" 2>/dev/null && jq -e 'type == "object"' "$j" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    98	      printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$group" "$n" "$d" "$j" >> "$WORK/tasks.tsv"
    99	    else
   100	      printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$group" "$n" "$d" "!" >> "$WORK/tasks.tsv"
   101	    fi
   102	  done
   103	done
   104	
   105	# Python does the schema, counts, allowlist, manifest, leakage and suite checks;
   106	# it prints violations, and `FIXTURE\t<id>\t<dir>` lines for the path rule below.
   107	python3 -I - "$WORK/tasks.tsv" "$WORK/suite.json" "$ROOT" "$REPO_ROOT" "$ALLOW_PARTIAL" "$PROMPTS_DIR" > "$WORK/out.txt" <<'PY' || { cat "$WORK/out.txt" >&2 2>/dev/null; die "validator crashed"; }
   108	import json, os, re, sys
   109	
   110	tasks_tsv, suite_json, root, repo, allow_partial, prompts_dir = sys.argv[1:7]
   111	allow_partial = allow_partial == "true"
   112	suite = json.load(open(suite_json))
   113	out = []
   114	def bad(tid, msg): out.append(f"{tid}: {msg}")
   115	
   116	TYPES = ["feature-build", "bug-fix", "refactor", "review-catch"]
   117	BUILD = {"feature-build", "bug-fix", "refactor"}
   118	ALLOW = {"python3", "pytest", "bats", "bash", "node", "npx"}
   119	KNOWN_TASK_TYPES = {"all", "build", "review-catch", "feature-build", "bug-fix", "refactor"}
   120	MOUNT_OWNED = (".claude", "CLAUDE.md", ".loa.config.yaml", "grimoires", ".run")
   121	REQUIRED = ["id", "schema_version", "type", "source", "post_cutoff", "fixture", "criterion",
   122	            "success_criterion", "test_command", "regression_command", "reference_patch",
   123	            "grader_protected", "structural_check", "bounds", "review_catch", "suite_version"]
   124	
   125	arms = [a for a in (suite.get("arms") or []) if isinstance(a, dict)]
   126	arm_ids = sorted({a.get("id") for a in arms if isinstance(a.get("id"), str)})
   127	for a in arms:
   128	    if a.get("absent") is True:
   129	        continue
   130	    tt = a.get("task_types")
   131	    if not isinstance(tt, list) or not tt:
   132	        bad("suite", f"arm {a.get('id')} has no task_types list")
   133	        continue
   134	    for t in tt:
   135	        if t not in KNOWN_TASK_TYPES:
   136	            bad("suite", f"arm {a.get('id')} task_types names unknown type '{t}'")
   137	suite_version = suite.get("suite_version")
   138	
   139	def rel_ok(p):
   140	    return isinstance(p, str) and p and not p.startswith("/") and ".." not in p.split("/") and "\\" not in p
   141	
   142	def is_str_list(v):
   143	    return isinstance(v, list) and all(isinstance(x, str) and x for x in v)
   144	
   145	def read(p):
   146	    try:
   147	        return open(p, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read()
   148	    except OSError:
   149	        return None
   150	
   151	prompt_texts = []
   152	if os.path.isdir(prompts_dir):
   153	    for f in sorted(os.listdir(prompts_dir)):
   154	        if f.endswith(".md"):
   155	            prompt_texts.append((f"phase-prompts/{f}", read(os.path.join(prompts_dir, f)) or ""))
   156	
   157	def leak_scan(tid, label, text, stems, defect_ids):
   158	    low = text.lower()
   159	    if "hidden" in low:
   160	        bad(tid, f"leak: {label} contains the string 'hidden'")
   161	    for s in stems:

   163	            bad(tid, f"leak: {label} names the grader file stem '{s}'")
   164	    for d in defect_ids:
   165	        if d in text:
   166	            bad(tid, f"leak: {label} names defect id '{d}'")
   167	    m = re.search(r"\bD[0-9]{2}-", text)
   168	    if m:

   170	    for a in arm_ids:
   171	        if re.search(r"(?<![A-Za-z0-9_])" + re.escape(a) + r"(?![A-Za-z0-9_])", text):
   172	            bad(tid, f"leak: {label} names arm id '{a}'")
   173

   175	seen = {}

   178	    if not line:

   181	    tid = f"{group}/{name}"
   182	    if jpath == "-":

   184	    if jpath == "!":

   192	    if not isinstance(t.get("id"), str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}", t.get("id") or ""):
   193	        bad(tid, "schema: id must match [a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,63}")
   194	    elif t["id"] in seen:

   196	    else:
   197	        seen[t["id"]] = tid
   198	    if t.get("schema_version") != 1:
   199	        bad(tid, "schema: schema_version must be 1")

   201	    if ttype not in TYPES:
   202	        bad(tid, f"schema: type '{ttype}' not in {'|'.join(TYPES)}")
   203	    elif group == "tasks":

   205	    src = t.get("source")
   206	    if not isinstance(src, dict):
   207	        bad(tid, "schema: source must be a mapping")

   216	        for k in src:

   218	                bad(tid, f"schema: source.{k} is not a known key")
   219	    if not isinstance(t.get("post_cutoff"), bool):

# 1. Establish project root
    PROJECT_ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)

    # 2. Load integrity enforcement level
    ENFORCEMENT="warn"  # Default
    if [[ -f "${PROJECT_ROOT}/.loa.config.yaml" ]]; then
        ENFORCEMENT=$(grep "^integrity_enforcement:" "${PROJECT_ROOT}/.loa.config.yaml" | awk '{print $2}' || echo "warn")
    fi

    echo "Running pre-flight integrity checks (enforcement: ${ENFORCEMENT})..." >&2

    # 3. Verify System Zone checksums
    if [[ "${ENFORCEMENT}" != "disabled" ]] && [[ -f "${PROJECT_ROOT}/.claude/checksums.json" ]]; then
        echo "Verifying System Zone integrity..." >&2

        # Simple check: compare file count (full SHA verification would be more thorough)
        EXPECTED_COUNT=$(jq -r '.files | length' "${PROJECT_ROOT}/.claude/checksums.json" 2>/dev/null || echo "0")
        # cycle-130 FR-1 (#1267): the manifest is generated from the TRACKED
        # .claude/ tree (tools/gen-checksums.sh), so count with the same rule:
        # git ls-files -- .claude minus overrides/ and the manifest. In a
        # submodule mount .claude/checksums.json links into the submodule; the
        # count is taken in the tree that owns the manifest.
        MANIFEST_TREE="${PROJECT_ROOT}"
        if [[ -L "${PROJECT_ROOT}/.claude/checksums.json" ]]; then
            MANIFEST_LINK=$(readlink "${PROJECT_ROOT}/.claude/checksums.json")
            [[ "${MANIFEST_LINK}" == /* ]] || MANIFEST_LINK="${PROJECT_ROOT}/.claude/${MANIFEST_LINK}"
            MANIFEST_TREE=$(cd "$(dirname "${MANIFEST_LINK}")/.." 2>/dev/null && pwd -P) || MANIFEST_TREE="${PROJECT_ROOT}"
        fi
        ACTUAL_COUNT=0
        if git -C "${MANIFEST_TREE}" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            ACTUAL_COUNT=$(git -C "${MANIFEST_TREE}" ls-files -- .claude \
                | awk '!/^\.claude\/overrides\// && $0 != ".claude/checksums.json"' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
        fi
        # No tracked .claude/ in that tree (outside git, or a standard-mode
        # downstream that does not commit .claude/): keep the legacy count.
        if [[ "${ACTUAL_COUNT}" -eq 0 ]]; then
            ACTUAL_COUNT=$(find "${PROJECT_ROOT}/.claude" -type f ! -path "*/.git/*" ! -path "*/overrides/*" ! -path "*/checksums.json" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')

    19	#      prompt_tree_commit, and whether .claude/ had uncommitted changes.

    21	#              --model $EVAL_MODEL [--effort <e>] --restricted --tools Read,Grep,Glob,Write
    22	#              --permission-mode acceptEdits --append-system-prompt-file <skill-prompt>
    23	#              --max-turns $EVAL_MAX_TURNS

1	#!/usr/bin/env bats
     2	bats_require_minimum_version 1.5.0
     3	# =============================================================================
     4	# tests/unit/check-loa-mount-scope.bats — cycle-130 Sprint 1 (PRD FR-1 #1267,
     5	# AC-1.2/AC-1.3; SDD §5.3). check-loa.sh check_integrity classifies every
     6	# manifest path as ok, Tampered (fail), not-mounted (a submodule mount does
     7	# not link it but .loa/<path> has it: counted, one summary line, never a
     8	# failure) or Missing (fail).
     9	#
    10	# Seam: check-loa.sh already guards `main` behind
    11	#   [[ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" == "$0" ]]
    12	# so each case sources the script in a child bash inside the fixture
    13	# directory and calls check_integrity alone; the child exits 1 when the
    14	# FAILURES counter is non-zero, the same rule main applies. No other check
    15	# runs, and the script is not modified for the test.
    16	# =============================================================================
    17	
    18	setup() {
    19	  ROOT="$(cd "$BATS_TEST_DIRNAME/../.." && pwd -P)"
    20	  CHECK="$ROOT/.claude/scripts/check-loa.sh"
    21	  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/cloams.XXXXXX")"
    22	  D="$T/downstream"
    23	  # upstream tree inside the submodule path
    24	  mkdir -p "$D/.loa/.claude/lib" "$D/.claude"
    25	  printf 'echo a\n' > "$D/.loa/.claude/a.sh"
    26	  printf 'echo b\n' > "$D/.loa/.claude/b.sh"
    27	  printf 'echo c\n' > "$D/.loa/.claude/lib/c.sh"
    28	  # the mount links a.sh only (b.sh and lib/c.sh are not linked)
    29	  ln -s ../.loa/.claude/a.sh "$D/.claude/a.sh"
    30	  printf 'aleph:\n  enabled: false\n' > "$D/.loa.config.yaml"
    31	  source "$ROOT/.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh"
    32	  HA="$(sha256_portable "$D/.loa/.claude/a.sh" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
    33	  HB="$(sha256_portable "$D/.loa/.claude/b.sh" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
    34	  HC="$(sha256_portable "$D/.loa/.claude/lib/c.sh" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
    35	  write_manifest
    36	}
    37	teardown() { find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true; rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true; }
    38	
    39	# write_manifest [extra-path hash]... — a/b/lib/c plus any extra pairs
    40	write_manifest() {
    41	  local args=(--arg a "$HA" --arg b "$HB" --arg c "$HC")
    42	  local filter='{".claude/a.sh": $a, ".claude/b.sh": $b, ".claude/lib/c.sh": $c}'
    43	  if [[ $# -ge 2 ]]; then
    44	    args+=(--arg xp "$1" --arg xh "$2")
    45	    filter="$filter + {(\$xp): \$xh}"
    46	  fi
    47	  jq -n "${args[@]}" "{generated: \"2026-10-15T00:00:00Z\", algorithm: \"sha256\", files: ($filter)}" \
    48	    > "$D/.claude/checksums.json"
    49	}
    50	
    51	run_integrity() {
    52	  run bash -c 'cd "$1" && source "$2" && check_integrity && echo "FAILURES=$FAILURES" && [[ $FAILURES -eq 0 ]]' \
    53	    _ "$D" "$CHECK"
    54	}
    55	
    56	@test "CM-1 paths in the upstream tree but not linked are not-mounted; exit unaffected" {
    57	  run_integrity
    58	  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
    59	  [[ "$output" == *"not-mounted: 2 path(s) exist in the upstream tree but are not linked by this mount"* ]]
    60	  [[ "$output" == *"Integrity verified"* ]]
    61	  [[ "$output" != *"Missing:"* ]]
    62	  [[ "$output" != *"Tampered:"* ]]
    63	  [ "$(grep -c 'not-mounted:' <<< "$output")" -eq 1 ]
    64	}
    65	
    66	@test "CM-2 a present file whose hash differs is Tampered and fails" {
    67	  rm -f "$D/.claude/a.sh"
    68	  printf 'echo tampered\n' > "$D/.claude/a.sh"
    69	  run_integrity
    70	  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
    71	  [[ "$output" == *"Tampered: .claude/a.sh"* ]]
    72	  [[ "$output" != *"Integrity verified"* ]]
    73	  [[ "$output" == *"FAILURES=1"* ]]
    74	}
    75	
    76	@test "CM-3 a path absent locally and upstream is Missing and fails" {
    77	  write_manifest .claude/gone.sh "$HA"
    78	  run_integrity
    79	  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
    80	  [[ "$output" == *"Missing: .claude/gone.sh"* ]]
    81	  [[ "$output" == *"not-mounted: 2 path(s)"* ]]
    82	  [[ "$output" != *"Integrity verified"* ]]
    83	}
    84	
    85	@test "CM-4 without a .loa/ submodule an absent path is Missing" {
    86	  find "$D/.loa" -mindepth 1 -delete
    87	  rmdir "$D/.loa"
    88	  printf 'echo a\n' > "$D/.claude/a.sh.real"
    89	  rm -f "$D/.claude/a.sh"
    90	  mv "$D/.claude/a.sh.real" "$D/.claude/a.sh"
    91	  run_integrity
    92	  [ "$status" -eq 1 ]
    93	  [[ "$output" == *"Missing: .claude/b.sh"* ]]
    94	  [[ "$output" == *"Missing: .claude/lib/c.sh"* ]]
    95	  [[ "$output" != *"not-mounted"* ]]
    96	}
    97	
    98	@test "CM-5 every path linked and matching: Integrity verified, no not-mounted line" {
    99	  ln -s ../.loa/.claude/b.sh "$D/.claude/b.sh"
   100	  mkdir -p "$D/.claude/lib"
   101	  ln -s ../../.loa/.claude/lib/c.sh "$D/.claude/lib/c.sh"
   102	  run_integrity
   103	  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
   104	  [[ "$output" == *"Integrity verified"* ]]
   105	  [[ "$output" != *"not-mounted"* ]]
   106	}
   107	
   108	@test "CM-6 no checksums file: warn and skip, no failure" {
   109	  rm -f "$D/.claude/checksums.json"
   110	  run_integrity
   111	  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
   112	  [[ "$output" == *"No checksums file - skipping integrity check"* ]]
   113	}

     3	# evals/tests/freeze.bats — cycle-130 Sprint 258 Task 1.11 (PRD AC-5.1, sprint
     4	# AC-1.13, SDD §5.13, DEC-0414)
     5	#
     6	# freeze.sh writes MANIFEST.sha256 over every file under tasks/ (smoke/ with
     7	# --smoke) after validate-suite.sh passes; --check recomputes and fails on any
     8	# drift, one changed byte included, naming the path.
     9	# =============================================================================
    10	
    11	setup() {
    12	  TESTS_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$BATS_TEST_FILENAME")" && pwd)"
    13	  REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$TESTS_DIR/../.." && pwd)"
    14	  FZ="$REPO_ROOT/evals/harness/freeze.sh"
    15	  T="$(mktemp -d "${BATS_TEST_TMPDIR:-/tmp}/fz.XXXXXX")"
    16	  R="$T/suite"; mkdir -p "$R"
    17	  export LOA_EVAL_PHASE_PROMPTS_DIR="$T/no-prompts"
    18	  # shellcheck source=fixtures/ablation/suite-lib.bash
    19	  source "$TESTS_DIR/fixtures/ablation/suite-lib.bash"
    20	  # shellcheck source=../../.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh
    21	  source "$REPO_ROOT/.claude/scripts/compat-lib.sh"
    22	  make_task "$R" tasks bug-fix-01 bug-fix
    23	  make_task "$R" tasks review-catch-01 review-catch
    24	}
    25	
    26	teardown() {
    27	  find "$T" -mindepth 1 -delete 2>/dev/null || true
    28	  rmdir "$T" 2>/dev/null || true
    29	}
    30	
    31	@test "FZ-1 freeze writes one sorted '<sha256>  <relpath>' line per file under tasks/; --check then passes" {
    32	  run "$FZ" --root "$R" --allow-partial
    33	  [ "$status" -eq 0 ]
    34	  grep -q '^freeze: wrote MANIFEST.sha256 (' <<<"$output"
    35	  M="$R/MANIFEST.sha256"
    36	  [ "$(grep -c . "$M")" -eq "$(cd "$R" && find tasks -type f | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" ]
    37	  [ "$(awk '{print $2}' "$M")" = "$(awk '{print $2}' "$M" | LC_ALL=C sort)" ]
    38	  ! grep -qv '^[0-9a-f]\{64\}  tasks/' "$M"
    39	  want="$(cd "$R" && sha256_portable tasks/bug-fix-01/task.yaml)"
    40	  grep -qxF "$want" "$M"
    41	  run "$FZ" --root "$R" --allow-partial --check

    44	}
    45

     2	# mount-lib-stub.sh — test stand-in for implementer B's evals/harness/lib/sandbox-mount.sh
     3	# (cycle-130 Sprint 258). pipeline-run.sh sources lib/sandbox-mount.sh by a literal
     4	# path; pipeline-run.bats (make_harness) and ablation-runs/regen.sh run a temporary
     5	# copy of the harness with THIS file in that place. Same function names, signatures
     6	# and return codes as B's contract (0 ok, 2 refused); evidence `key=value` lines go
     7	# to stdout (the driver appends them to $ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE); the gates toggle writes
     8	# LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false to $ARM_ENV_FILE as B's library does. The
     9	# behaviour is deliberately small: copy the prompt tree's .claude/, CLAUDE.md and
    10	# .loa.config.yaml; apply the toggles the tests check; hash .claude/ with hashlib.
    11	#   STUB_MOUNT_FAIL=<fn>   make that function return 2 (infrastructure path)
    12	#   STUB_BRIEF_EXTRA=<s>   appended to task-brief.md (leak-guard cases)
    13	#   STUB_ARM_ENV_EXTRA=<l> an extra line written to $ARM_ENV_FILE (env filter case)
    14	
    15	_stub_fail() { [[ "${STUB_MOUNT_FAIL:-}" == "$1" ]] && { echo "stub: $1 refused" >&2; return 0; }; return 1; }
    16	
    17	mount_prompt_surface() {  # <ws> <prompt_tree> <skill|->
    18	  _stub_fail mount_prompt_surface && return 2

    27	resolve_arm_toggles() {  # <arm> <suite_file>

    29	  local def

    31	  [[ -n "$def" ]] || { echo "stub: arm $1 undeclared" >&2; return 2; }

    39	  if [[ "$(jq -r '.companion_voice' <<<"$tg")" == false ]]; then
    40	    yq -i '.flatline_protocol.code_review.companion_voice = false | .flatline_protocol.security_audit.companion_voice = false' "$cfg"

    44	    yq -i '.flatline_protocol.code_review.enabled = false | .flatline_protocol.security_audit.enabled = false' "$cfg"
    45	    echo "gates=false"; echo "arm_env=LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false"
    46	    [[ -n "${ARM_ENV_FILE:-}" ]] && echo "LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false" >> "$ARM_ENV_FILE"
    47	  fi

    49	    yq -i '.flatline_protocol.enabled = false' "$cfg"; echo "flatline=false"

    54	      [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue

    62	  [[ -n "${STUB_ARM_ENV_EXTRA:-}" && -n "${ARM_ENV_FILE:-}" ]] && printf '%s\n' "$STUB_ARM_ENV_EXTRA" >> "$ARM_ENV_FILE"

    64	}

    69	import hashlib, json, os, sys

    73	    for n in names:

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# =============================================================================
     3	# evals/harness/lib/sandbox-mount.sh — sandbox materialisation and arm toggles
     4	#
     5	# cycle-130 Sprint 258 Task 1.6 (SDD D-4.5, DEC-0421, DEC-0423, DEC-0396).
     6	# Extracted from execute-agent.sh (cycle-129 step 2 and the toggle functions)
     7	# WITHOUT behaviour change for the cycle-129 single-skill path, and shared with
     8	# pipeline-run.sh. Source it; it defines functions only and sets no shell
     9	# options (the caller runs under `set -euo pipefail`).
    10	#
    11	# Contract (every function returns 0 on success, 2 when refused / when a step
    12	# cannot take effect; refusals name the reason on one stderr line):
    13	#
    14	#   mount_prompt_surface <ws> <prompt_tree> <skill|->
    15	#       skill given: <ws>/.claude/skills/<skill>/ (whole dir), .claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md,
    16	#       .claude/rules/, CLAUDE.md = "@.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"; the prompt tree's
    17	#       .loa.config.yaml only in arm mode (LOA_EVAL_ARM set), as cycle-129 did.
    18	#       skill "-": the whole .claude/ tree is copied (files, never a symlink to the
    19	#       tree), CLAUDE.md as above, and .loa.config.yaml always (the pipeline
    20	#       executor needs every skill, hook and script). Evidence: mount=skill:<s>|tree.
    21	#   resolve_arm_toggles <arm> <suite_file>
    22	#       prints the arm's toggles as compact JSON on stdout. Arms are read from
    23	#       `.arms[]` (ablation-2.0) and `.ab.arms[]` (recall suites). An arm with
    24	#       toggles {} (a1_full, baseline) prints {}; `baseline` undeclared prints {}.
    25	#       Exit 2: undeclared arm (an unreadable suite file declares none), `absent: true` arm.
    26	#   apply_arm_toggles <ws> <toggles_json> <arm>
    27	#       applies every toggle to the SANDBOX COPY and verifies it afterwards; exit 2
    28	#       when one cannot take effect or is unknown. Toggles and values:
    29	#         companion_voice: false  flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.companion_voice=false
    30	#         karpathy_block: false   '## Karpathy Principles' out of CLAUDE.loa.md (+ constraints.json rows)
    31	#         rule_files: false       stash-safety.md, skill-invariants.md out of .claude/rules/
    32	#         audit_delta_instruction: false  the delta paragraph out of auditing-security/SKILL.md
    33	#         loa_mount: false        verifies no .claude/, CLAUDE.md, .loa.config.yaml in <ws>
    34	#                                 (the caller skips mount_prompt_surface); evidence loa_mount=none
    35	#         effort: low|medium|high|xhigh|max
    36	#                                 every `effort:` line out of the frontmatter of every
    37	#                                 <ws>/.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md; every `default_effort` key in
    38	#                                 <ws>/.claude/defaults/model-config.yaml set to the value and its
    39	#                                 .checksum (bare sha256 hex) refreshed when present.
    40	#                                 The caller passes `--effort <v>` on argv.
    41	#         gates: false            flatline_protocol.{code_review,security_audit}.enabled=false;
    42	#                                 LOA_ADVERSARIAL_REVIEW_ENFORCE=false exported in the CALLING shell
    43	#                                 and written to $ARM_ENV_FILE (KEY=VALUE lines) when that is set
    44	#         flatline: false         flatline_protocol.enabled=false
    45	#         sprint_plan: false, context_resets: false
    46	#                                 phase-set edits owned by the pipeline executor; recorded as
    47	#                                 evidence here (the single-skill executor refuses them itself)
    48	#   regen_sandbox_manifest <ws>
    49	#       writes <ws>/.claude/checksums.json {generated, algorithm: sha256, files} over
    50	#       every regular file under <ws>/.claude except overrides/ and the manifest
    51	#       itself (LC_ALL=C order, sha256). tools/gen-checksums.sh (in the
    52	#       prompt tree, $EVAL_PROMPT_TREE) is used instead when it exists AND <ws> is a
    53	#       git repository tracking .claude files (it lists `git ls-files`). No .claude/
    54	#       (loa_mount: false) → manifest_sha256=none, exit 0. Prints manifest_sha256=<hex>.
    55	#   check_fixture_path_rule <fixture_dir>
    56	#       exit 2 (offending paths on stderr) when the fixture's top level holds
    57	#       .claude, CLAUDE.md, .loa.config.yaml, grimoires or .run — the mount owns
    58	#       those paths (DEC-0396); exit 0 otherwise.
    59	#   write_sandbox_grimoire <ws> <task_yaml> <arm> <sprint_label>
    60	#       grimoires/loa/ledger.json (one active cycle, <sprint_label> planned, global 1;
    61	#       the ledger-lib.sh schema), NOTES.md (header only), context/task-brief.md (the
    62	#       task's agent-facing `criterion` + the TASK.md next to task.yaml),
    63	#       a2a/<sprint_label>/ (empty); review-catch tasks also get a one-sprint
    64	#       grimoires/loa/sprint.md naming pr/head.diff and a2a/<sprint_label>/reviewer.md
    65	#       carrying pr/PR.md (sandbox copy, else the corpus fixture's). An arm whose
    66	#       toggles carry sprint_plan: false (resolved from $LOA_EVAL_SUITE_FILE, default
    67	#       evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml) gets NO sprint.md. Build tasks leave sprint.md
    68	#       to the PLAN phase. Nothing written names the arm.
    69	#   init_sandbox_beads <ws> <task_title>
    70	#       `br init --prefix bd --no-daemon` in <ws> plus one task bead with the title
    71	#       when br ($LOA_EVAL_BR_BIN, default br) is on PATH → beads=br; else the opt-out
    72	#       marker through <ws>/.claude/scripts/beads/update-beads-state.sh --opt-out →
    73	#       beads=opt-out; neither → beads=none (exit 0).
    74	#
    75	# Hashing is Python hashlib (_sm_sha256), never .claude/ code: see _sm_sha256.
    76	# Callers source this file by a literal relative path (no variable expansion
    77	# on the source line), as eval.yml's trust-boundary scan requires.
    78	#
    79	# Evidence: every function reports `key=value` lines (one line, no newline in
    80	# the value). When ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE is set they are appended to that file;
    81	# else they go to the descriptor in SANDBOX_MOUNT_EVIDENCE_FD (default 1).
    82	# resolve_arm_toggles prints JSON on stdout and no evidence.
    83	#
    84	# Tested by evals/tests/arm-toggles.bats (directly and through execute-agent.sh)
    85	# and evals/tests/execute-agent.bats.
    86	# =============================================================================
    87	
    88	[[ "${_SANDBOX_MOUNT_LOADED:-}" == "true" ]] && return 0
    89	_SANDBOX_MOUNT_LOADED=true
    90	
    91	_SM_LIB_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    92	_SM_REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$_SM_LIB_DIR/../../.." && pwd)"
    93	
    94	_sm_err() { echo "ERROR: $*" >&2; }
    95	
    96	# _sm_sha256 <file>... prints "<hex>  <file>" lines, the sha256sum output shape.
    97	# Python hashlib, not compat-lib's sha256_portable: the eval workflow runs the
    98	# harness as the trusted copy against a PR's .claude/, so no harness script
    99	# sources .claude/ code (eval.yml "Validate grader trust boundary"); run-arms.sh
   100	# hashes the corpus the same way.
   101	_sm_sha256() {
   102	  python3 -I -c '
   103	import hashlib, sys
   104	for p in sys.argv[1:]:
   105	    h = hashlib.sha256()
   106	    with open(p, "rb") as f:
   107	        for b in iter(lambda: f.read(1 << 20), b""):
   108	            h.update(b)
   109	    print(h.hexdigest() + "  " + p)' "$@"
   110	}
   111	
   112	# _sm_evidence <key> <value> — one key=value line to the evidence sink.
   113	_sm_evidence() {
   114	  local line="$1=${2//$'\n'/ }"
   115	  if [[ -n "${ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE:-}" ]]; then
   116	    printf '%s\n' "$line" >> "$ARM_EVIDENCE_FILE"
   117	  else
   118	    local fd="${SANDBOX_MOUNT_EVIDENCE_FD:-1}"
   119	    [[ "$fd" =~ ^[0-9]$ ]] || fd=1
   120	    printf '%s\n' "$line" >&"$fd"
   121	  fi
   122	}
   123	
   124	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   125	mount_prompt_surface() {
   126	  local ws="$1" tree="$2" skill="${3:-}"
   127	  [[ -d "$ws" ]] || { _sm_err "mount_prompt_surface: workspace not found: $ws"; return 2; }
   128	  [[ -d "$tree/.claude" ]] || { _sm_err "mount_prompt_surface: prompt tree has no .claude/: $tree"; return 2; }
   129	  if [[ "$skill" == "-" ]]; then
   130	    mkdir -p "$ws/.claude"
   131	    cp -a "$tree/.claude/." "$ws/.claude/" || { _sm_err "mount_prompt_surface: copying .claude/ failed"; return 2; }
   132	    printf '@.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md\n' > "$ws/CLAUDE.md"
   133	    if [[ -f "$tree/.loa.config.yaml" ]]; then cp "$tree/.loa.config.yaml" "$ws/.loa.config.yaml"; fi
   134	    _sm_evidence mount "tree"
   135	    return 0
   136	  fi
   137	  case "$skill" in */*|.*|'') _sm_err "invalid skill name '$skill'"; return 2 ;; esac
   138	  local skill_src="$tree/.claude/skills/$skill"

   141	  # Whole skill dir (resources included) so guarded reads inside the skill resolve.
   142	  local skill_dst="$ws/.claude/skills/$skill"
   143	  mkdir -p "$skill_dst"
   144	  cp -a "$skill_src/." "$skill_dst/"
   145	  if [[ -f "$tree/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md" ]]; then
   146	    cp "$tree/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md" "$ws/.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md"
   147	  fi
   148	  if [[ -d "$tree/.claude/rules" ]]; then
   149	    mkdir -p "$ws/.claude/rules"
   150	    cp -a "$tree/.claude/rules/." "$ws/.claude/rules/"
   151	  fi
   152	  printf '@.claude/loa/CLAUDE.loa.md\n' > "$ws/CLAUDE.md"
   153	  if [[ -n "${LOA_EVAL_ARM+x}" && -f "$tree/.loa.config.yaml" ]]; then
   154	    cp "$tree/.loa.config.yaml" "$ws/.loa.config.yaml"
   155	  fi
   156	  _sm_evidence mount "skill:$skill"
   157	  return 0
   158	}
   159	
   160	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   161	resolve_arm_toggles() {
   162	  local arm="$1" suite_file="${2:-}"
   163	  [[ "$arm" =~ ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$ ]] || { _sm_err "invalid arm id '$arm'"; return 2; }

   166	    # an unreadable suite file reads as "not declared" (cycle-129 behaviour: baseline still resolves to {})

   168	      || entry=""

   170	  fi
   171	  if [[ "$found" -eq 0 ]]; then
   172	    [[ "$arm" == "baseline" ]] && { printf '{}'; return 0; }

   174	    return 2
   175	  fi
